texts.html: This is the graphic identity for the Salomon Theatre. The Salomon Theatre is a student and faculty run theatre on the campus of PLNU. Because the Salomon Theatre employs many different designers and artists, the identity created needed to be flexible enough to work with any artist’s style and easy enough for any designer to apply. Below are the bulletins and posters I made during my tenure as a designer for the Salomon Theatre as well as the brand’s guidelines.
